main_text.p: עָרוֹם m. Nudus, Gen.3.10. Nuditas, Deut.28.48. Plur. עֵירֻמִּים Nudi, Gen.3.7.
עָרְמָה f. Astutia, Proverb.1.4. Aff. בְּעָרְמָם In astutia ipsorum, Job.5.13. contractè pro בְּעָרְמָתָם, cui simile vide in סָחָה.
עַרְמָה f. Acervus, Ruth 3.7. Construct. עַרְמַת חִטִּים Acervus triticorum, Cant.7.2. Plur. עַרְמוֹת Acervi, 2.Par.31.v.6. Et mascul. עַרְמִים Acervi, Jer.50.26.
מְעֻרָמִים m.pl. Nudi: Aff. מְעֻרָמֵיהֶם Nudos eorum, 2.Par.28.15.
* עַרְמוֹן m. Platanus arbor: Hebraei, Castanea arbor, Gen.30.37. Plural. עַרְמֹנִים Castanea, Ezech.31.8.
עֲרִיסוֹת f.p. Massæ, farina sc. aquâ conspersa: Aff. עֲרִיסֹתֵיכֶם Massarum vestrarum, Num.15.20.
עֹרֶף m. Cervix, Exod.23.27. Aff. עָרְפּוֹ Cervicis ejus, Lev.5.8. וַעֲרַפְתֶּם Et cervicem vestram, Deut.10.16.

עָרַף Decollavit, quasi Decervicare dicas: Item Stillavit: idem quod עָרַף. Præt. וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ Et decollabis ipsum, Exo.13.v.13. וְעָרְפוּ Decollabunt, Deut.21.4. Part. עָרֵף Decollat, Jes.66.3. Part. Præt. fœm. הָעֲרוּפָה Decollata, Deut.21.v.6. Fut. יַעֲרֹף Decollabit, id est, Decutiet, Diruet, Hos.10.2. Et secundùm alteram significationem, יַעֲרֹף Stillet, Deut.32.2. יַעַרְפוּ Stillabunt, Deut.33.28.

עֲרִיפִים m.p. Ruinæ, ex significatione verbi Hos.10.2. juxta Aben Esram. Aff. בַּעֲרִיפָיו In ruinis ejus, nempe Terræ, quò Affixum fœmininum referendum est, Jes.5.30. Quidam, In caligine ejus; Alii, In stillationibus ejus, sc. lucis; & tunc discrepantia generis est in Affixo.
עַרְפֶּל m. Caligo, Job.22.13. לִשְׁכֹּן בְּעַרְפֶּל Habitare in caligine, 1.Reg.8.12.

page.notes: Page number and running head are partly stained; "387" read with doubt. Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew words in the scan are blurred and were copied as far as legible; the spelling of the vowel signs is not fully certain throughout. The large initial of "עֲרִיסוֹת" is printed as a large word head. Two Hebrew forms ("וַעֲרַפְתֶּם" and "בַּעֲרִיפָיו") and the Hebrew in the entry "עָרְמָה" beside "סָחָה" are doubtful.
